confidence.rationale: The packet covers 48 affected baseline items, reconciled as 42 exact matches, 1 variant match, and 5 artifacts. Reopening the restaurant-issued homepage and menu independently confirms all five extraction artifacts and the Chicken & Waffles scope inconsistency. The menu also lacks an allergen legend, matrix, cross-contact policy, or complete item-level allergen declarations, so its narrative ingredient descriptions cannot establish complete allergen arrays.

confirmedFindings: Affected baseline and reconciliation totals: 48 items; 42 exact_match/accurately_unavailable, 1 variant_match/accurately_unavailable, and 5 artifact/not_applicable.

Four baseline records are promotional or employment content rather than food items: We are hiring!, a place where flavors come together in the best style, Book your next party with us!, and Start Your Next Adventure With Us.
The baseline record named “Rich bread pudding with bourbon glaze • Whole 9in pan” is a description under the actual Bourbon Bread Pudding item, making it the fifth extraction artifact.
Chicken & Waffles appears separately in the Lunch & Dinner and Brunch sections, while the frozen record combines a Brunch category with the Lunch & Dinner variant group.

The official menu provides narrative ingredient descriptions but no allergen legend, matrix, cross-contact statement, or complete item-level allergen declarations; therefore complete direct-allergen arrays remain unverifiable from the public primary source.

additionalEvidence.summary: Confirms restaurant identity and address and shows the promotional, party, and employment text that was incorrectly extracted as food records.

Confirms the current menu structure, both Chicken & Waffles variants, Bourbon Bread Pudding with the nested description, and the absence of a published allergen guide or complete item-level declarations.
Restaurant-linked ordering endpoint remained inaccessible in the review environment and supplied no contrary evidence.

summary: Terra’s discrepancy_found outcome is upheld. The five extraction artifacts are directly demonstrated by the current restaurant-issued pages, the Chicken & Waffles scope mismatch is real, and no public primary source supports complete allergen verification.
